templates.title: Host a static website
templates.summary: Your files stay private in S3. CloudFront, AWS's worldwide delivery network, serves them, and Origin Access Control lets only CloudFront read the bucket.
templates.costNote: Usually $0 for a small site that stays within CloudFront's free allowance or your Free Tier credits. S3 storage costs pennies.

templates.title: Serverless API
templates.summary: An HTTP API in API Gateway that invokes a Lambda function with a least-privilege role.
templates.costNote: Lambda: 1M free requests a month. HTTP API: older accounts get 1M free calls a month for their first 12 months. Newer accounts use Free Tier credits instead.

templates.title: On-demand DynamoDB table
templates.summary: A pay-per-request table with a partition key and point-in-time recovery.
templates.costNote: On-demand: pay per request, plus storage and point-in-time-recovery backups per GB-month; pennies for a small table.

templates.title: Queue + worker
templates.summary: An SQS queue with a dead-letter queue, drained by a Lambda function.
templates.costNote: Free Tier: 1M SQS requests and 1M Lambda requests per month.
